requirement: every DSH audit behaviour is re-homed into exactly four colours; green/blue run without interruption, yellow asks the operator, red is denied outright, and an operation approved for the session becomes blue on its next occurrence

assertions.green: read-only tools/commands, allow-listed commands, workspace (L2) writes -> allow
assertions.blue: fingerprint approved earlier in this session -> allow as an established grant
assertions.yellow: out-of-workspace writes, non-whitelisted exec, medium-risk commands, unknown tools -> GPW pending queue with colour
assertions.red: dangerous-command blacklist, sensitive paths, system paths, explicit deny folders -> denied by guard and pre-execute
assertions.marking: state route exposes per-colour counters and per-item colours; the panel shows the legend, counts and coloured rows
assertions.session_grant: pending decision allow / allow-session records the fingerprint; the next identical call is blue
assertions.p2p_flake: the direct-path p2p push case waits 60 s and skips by name (ACCEPTED_SKIPS: p2p-direct-path-timeout) instead of reddening the release gate when the runner has no usable UDP path
